retrievalProfile.description: A surreal, motion-blurred pastoral scene featuring a lion and running human figures with high-contrast sans-serif typography.
triggerTerms: motion blurred running figures with lion

recipe.visualDefinition: A grainy, motion-blurred photograph of a man and woman running alongside a large male lion through a lush green field, topped with bold, tightly tracked sans-serif display type.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal motion blur across the entire frame
Lion in the foreground anchoring the movement
Human figures positioned behind the lion in mid-stride
Typography layered over the upper third of the image
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and horizontal motion streaks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The lion occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled large; human figures are mid-ground, scaled to match the lion's length.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark mane of the lion provides the central point of contrast.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Strong left-to-right horizontal movement following the direction of the run.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with the texture of the grass and the subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Verdant green (background grass and motion blur)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm flesh tones and yellow typography
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in greens with muted, naturalistic tones for the subjects.

letterConstructionRules: Tight tracking with occasional character overlap
Italicized or slanted for motion emphasis
characterSpecificRedesigns: Apostrophes and numbers integrated into the tight line spacing
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single family with weight and color variation for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Record label logos in bottom right

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric weight and 1960s era feel.
Provides the necessary density and impact.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, 1960s film-style photograph of a man and woman running through a tall green grass field alongside a large male lion. Apply heavy horizontal motion blur and a verdant green color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of bold, uppercase sans-serif text in the top third. The first line should be yellow and the second line white, both with extremely tight tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the motion blur horizontal and consistent?
Is the typography tightly tracked and bold?
Does the image have a visible film grain texture?
Are the colors dominated by organic greens?

postGenerationChecks: Check for horizontal motion streaks across subjects
Verify the lion's mane is the darkest point of the image
Ensure text is legible despite tight tracking
Confirm the green palette feels pastoral and saturated
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject in Motion] + [Animal Companion] + [Pastoral Setting] + [Horizontal Motion Blur] + [Tight 60s Sans-Serif Type].
